description: Answer 'is this cluster safe to launch on?' BEFORE you burn GPU-hours on a job that will die in the first ten minutes. Feed it the health artifacts from the nodes you are about to use, `nvidia-smi -q`, `ibstat`, `nvidia-smi topo -m`, `dmesg -T`, and it returns the critical blockers (dead links, missing GPUs, non-NVLink topology, driver mismatch) that would take the run down. Scale+ feature.

dir.description: Directory to scan for the newest artifact file.

file.description: Path to a file containing them.

logs.description: Paste the health artifacts (nvidia-smi -q, ibstat, nvidia-smi topo -m, dmesg -T).

name: preflight_check

passed.description: FALSE when any check is critical, do not launch.

title: Preflight a cluster before a large job
